fit: oral stigma extract with active comparator in major depression

fit: oral petal extract with active comparator in major depression
assessment: Petal and fluoxetine mean HAM-D changes were −12.00 and −13.50 points (p=.30). Confirmed twice-daily capsule schedule. Floral part, comparator and population limit transfer.
The POMS depression interaction was p=.02 in intention-to-treat and inconclusive per protocol. This is a processed stigma extract comparison in a different population.

fit: insomnia adverse events in major depression
assessment: Insomnia was recorded in three participants per arm. No specific insomnia severity measure, oral ground stigma or Parkinson population.

fit: ISI after three mixed intranasal botanical oils
